$schema_note: Machine-readable provider identity for DigitalOcean. Derived from ../evidence/DIGITALOCEAN_PROVIDER_DISCOVERY.md — never hand-invented. Do not add a fact here that isn't traceable to that evidence file.

auth_methods.name: Personal Access Token
auth_methods.scope_model: resource:action, immutable after creation (must reissue to change scope)
auth_methods.notes: Created via Control Panel (Account > API > Tokens) or API; secret shown once at creation; user-set expiry interval; deleting revokes immediately.

auth_methods.name: OAuth 2.0
auth_methods.notes: Authorize step requires interactive user consent (not automatable); token exchange step is automatable. Recommended for multi-account/team automation per Owner's stated long-term direction — system can self-refresh instead of an AI holding every user's PAT.

auth_methods.name: Spaces Access Key/Secret
auth_methods.used_for: Spaces S3-compatible data-plane calls only (bucket/object operations)
auth_methods.corrected_2026_08_17: Key creation/management IS automatable via /v2/spaces/keys (standard v2 API, PAT/OAuth bearer + spaces_key:* scopes). Only the resulting key/secret PAIR is used for the separate AWS-Sig-v4 data-plane calls — that data-plane auth mechanism itself is unchanged.
auth_methods.notes: Do not confuse the two layers: (1) managing the Spaces key resource = standard v2 API + spaces_key:* scope; (2) using the key to call the Spaces S3-compatible endpoint = AWS Signature v4, not a DO scope at all.

auth_methods.name: Inference bearer auth
accepted_token_prefixes: agent_access_key (agent-scoped, not interchangeable with account tokens)
auth_methods.notes: Dedicated Inference uses the standard v2 host + dedicated_inference:* scopes instead — do not assume all three Inference products share one auth path.

account_model.description: All resources and billing are scoped to a Team, not an individual account.

organization.purpose: optional layer grouping multiple Teams under consolidated billing/invoicing

account_model.billing_prerequisite: a payment method must be added to the Team before any billable resource can be created or additional members invited

cli.name: doctl
cli.auth_model: stores a PAT locally under a named context; doctl auth switch --context <name> for multi-account

mcp_server.auth: bearer PAT in client config headers — same credential/scope model as REST API

webhooks_events_api.notes: No officially documented general webhooks/events subscription API was found anywhere in the platform. This is a confirmed absence, not a research gap.

rate_limits.confidence: community-sourced, not independently re-verified via direct fetch of a docs.digitalocean.com page — spot-check before relying on this as authoritative
